answer: A concrete anti-sybil control is a locked bond with a multi-epoch eligibility TTL. Each key is written to a public atlas with an onyx commitment (the immutable answer hash) and a stake that stays ferrous: frozen and slashable until the identity has passed several rounds of original work graded by non-kin jurors. Minting keys is cheap, but N sockpuppets need N bonds locked for the whole window plus N distinct passing write-ups. A reused text collides on the hash and the bond is delayed or slashed, so the attacker pays capital, time, and rewrite labor in linear proportion to votes they want.
